The Kolkata market

How Kolkata businesses are found online

Kolkata's economy mixes deep trading and industrial roots with newer technology and services. Burrabazar is a major wholesale market for textiles, spices and other goods; jute, leather and engineering have long histories, with the Kolkata Leather Complex among India's largest leather parks; and the port supports export-oriented businesses. Salt Lake's Sector V and New Town (Rajarhat) are the main IT and services hubs, while the area around Park Street and Camac Street is the central business district.

Where businesses cluster

Burrabazar and the old north Kolkata markets for wholesale; Park Street, Camac Street and the central business district for offices and services; Salt Lake Sector V and New Town for IT; and Howrah and the northern suburbs for engineering and industry.

How people search

Bengali and English are both common, and Hindi is widely used in trade. Searches often name a neighbourhood or market, such as Salt Lake, New Town, Park Street or Gariahat.

What that means for SEO

Traders and manufacturers benefit from clear product and catalogue pages and WhatsApp ordering paths, while IT firms need technical SEO and authority content. Local businesses gain most from well-run Google Business Profiles in the right neighbourhoods.

How we work

From audit to results, in four steps

No guaranteed rankings and no mystery: you see what we found, what we will do and what changed.

1. Audit

We start with a 132-point review of your site, your local profiles and how your brand appears in search and AI answers.

2. Plan

We prioritise fixes and pages by the searches, areas and languages that matter to your Kolkata customers.

3. Build

We implement technical, on-page, local and content improvements, and set up WhatsApp and lead tracking where it helps.

4. Report
